description: Fix broken model select popovers and improve provider list UX on AI Settings page

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect Popover for Headless UI v2
tasks.description: Remove the Transition wrapper around Popover.Panel in ModelSelect component (lines 257-265 of AiSettingsSection.tsx). Render Popover.Panel directly so it works with @headlessui/react v2.2.10. Also remove Transition from the import statement.
acceptanceCriteria: Transition wrapper removed from ModelSelect Popover.Panel
tasks.notes: This fixes all 7+ popover instances (Mohist Model, Coder Model, 5 Stage Overrides) since they all use the same ModelSelect component.

tasks.title: Reorder sections and add collapsible unconfigured providers
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#AI Settings Provider 列表布局
tasks.description: Reorder AiSettingsSection JSX to: Model Selection → Connected Providers → Custom Providers → Available Providers (collapsible) → Stage Overrides. Split the flat provider list into separate connected and unconfigured groups. Add a collapsible section for unconfigured providers using useState + ChevronRightIcon toggle (matching the Stage Model Overrides pattern), defaulting to collapsed with a count badge.
acceptanceCriteria: Model Selection section appears before Provider sections
Connected providers render in their own group
Unconfigured providers render in a separate collapsible section
Collapsed state shows provider count badge
ChevronRightIcon rotation toggle works for unconfigured section
tasks.notes: The existing sortedProviders/filteredProviders memos may need to be split into separate memos for configured and unconfigured providers.
